title: Preview Operator Decision Input
description: Operator decision on preview render quality. Must be provided by a human operator. Agent must never choose the visual verdict.

operator_verdict.description: Operator verdict on preview quality. accepted_for_voice_stage enables voice readiness preparation but does NOT equal production_accepted.

operator_notes.description: Free-text notes from the operator about the preview quality, issues, or required changes.

visual_review_performed_by_operator.description: Must be true. Indicates a human operator performed the visual review of preview artifacts.

preview_lowres_reviewed.description: Operator reviewed the low-resolution MP4 preview.

production_accepted.description: MUST be false. Production acceptance is a separate downstream gate and must not be set here.
